# awscc_backup_legal_hold (Data Source)

## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the legal hold.
- `creation_date` (String) The time when the legal hold was created.
- `description` (String) The description of the legal hold.
- `legal_hold_id` (String) The ID of the legal hold.
- `recovery_point_selection` (Attributes) The criteria to assign a set of resources, such as resource types or backup vaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recovery_point_selection))
- `status` (String) The status of the legal hold.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Optional tags to include. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
